_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/skills_tree.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The Skills screen (D243) with the tree as a wheel of webs (D252), in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648. Screen pieces have "at", their top left, shadow counted. The tree lives in its own space (pixels at 100%) and the screen is a camera on it: a point p of the tree is on the screen at (p - camera) * zoom + look, clipped to "view". Tree pieces are drawn "scale" times bigger than at 100%: draw one at zoom / scale, its "middle" on the point. Every place, size, colour and number here is a setting, and every word a placeholder. Draw order: ground; strands (under everything); beads; nodes; skills (ring, medallion, plate); rosette; names; then the panels, which stay put.

panel._note: Any plate up to 260 x 420: the big piece's top left part (w - cut by h - cut) and its right, bottom and corner edges of "cut" pixels, never stretched (the page's panelAt).

signs._note: A web node's sign, white on clear: "Sign <name>.png", 96 px for its 24 units. Tint it and draw it at "size" times the node's radius on screen across (small nodes and bridges "small", named nodes "node", notables "notable"). Under 8.5 px across, draw a dot of radius "dot" times the node's radius instead.

zoom._note: Opens at "open" with the camera on "home"; the zoom figure flies back there. Scroll: "wheel" a notch, the buttons "step" a click, between "min" and "max". A medallion flies into its web ("into") at 1. Under "far": small nodes are dots, unlit strands, beads and rings are not drawn, names hidden. From "near": named nodes show their names. From "side_names": each side's name. Medallions and the rosette never drawn under "medallion_min".

tree._note: Positions are the tree's space at 100%. A web node: "kind" small, node (a named node, round), notable (a named node, diamond), bridge (costs either skill's point and counts for both, D252) or stub (a bridge kept for a later skill, never open). "colour" picks its side's colour in "colours.sides" (e left, g right, t stem, x bridge, c later). "links" join keys in the same web (m0 is the first bead); "cross" joins a key to "<skill>/<key>" in the next web. A material bead's "ring" is a dotted arc round the root, degrees clockwise from 3 o'clock. A later skill has 8 "blank" nodes: "after" is the one it hangs from (-1: the fork).

hub._note: Round a medallion, at the medallion zoom zz = max(z, medallion_min): clicked within hit x zz; the ring of points to spend at ring x zz + plus_gap, its +n at ring x zz + 5 below; the plate plate_dy x zz below (+ under_100 under 100%, + with_points when it has points).

look_of._note: How the page draws what is not a piece. Widths are screen pixels at zoom z. Strands: lit = a dark under-line (w + 1.6), the side's colour (w), a pale line on top (max(.6, .3 w)); unlit = one line in "unlit". A lit strand is w = .72 x max(1.6, 3 x max(.6, z)); unlit .9 x max(1.4, 2 x max(.6, z)). A bridge strand to another web is drawn only its first 60 x z px, dashed 3, 4, until it is crossed. The spoke from the root to a hub: lit unless a later skill. Rings: dotted 2.5 z, 3.5 z, max(1, .8 z) wide, "ring_on" once the material is reached. An open node glows in its side's colour from .7 r to r + (small 6, else 10) x max(1, .8 z), .4 at its middle. A taken web node gets a thin ring of its colour at r + 1.7 z (a notable: a diamond at r + 3 z). A bridge or stub: a second ring at r + 2.2 z. The picked thing: a ring "picked" 2 px at r + 4. Pointed at: a ring "pointed" at r + 3. A skill with points to spend: a blue ring 2.2 px at 28 z + 4, a blue glow, "+n" under it. The route to a node pointed at: a dashed line 6, 5 through it, "route_ok" or "route_no". Haze: a radial glow of the side's colour, .07 at its middle, behind each side of a web.

timings._note: Seconds, the page's (skills_tree_page.mjs), all placeholders (D175). Short, eased out, nothing loops (Michael, 2026-11-19). "open": the screen fades in. "strand": the light runs along a taken node's strand. "route_step": between the nodes of a route. "burst": the thin ring round a node just taken, after its strand. "bead": the glow of a material just reached. "ring": a skill's ring easing to its new level. "earned": the blue ring of a point just earned. "zoom": the view gliding to a new zoom.

rules._note: The screen's numbers for D242 and D252, all placeholders: a point every "point_every" levels; a named node also needs a mark, one at each of "marks", so 4 named nodes at most (v1 only); a node needs its level and a taken node beside it (the first bead starts every route); a node whose skill drops below its level goes dark. The game's own rules will live in game/data/ once the server knows skills: this is what the screen shows, not what it decides.

text._note: "mid" text has its capitals centred on y; "top" text starts its line at y. Outline 2 px in "outline" where marked.

plate._note: Under each medallion: a plate cut from Panel, the name in "label" then the level in "value" (a later skill: "later" in "hint"). Its middle is at hub + (0, 40 z), + 4 under 100%, + 12 when the skill has points to spend. Face "title", "line" when far. Height 26 (20 far); padding 12 (8 far), gap 7 (5 far), right padding 12 (8 far).

baseline._note: Where the baseline sits below y, in px of the face: "mid" text (capitals centred on y), and "top" text by face.

panels._note: What stays put, in the window's pixels. "skills": Skills (heading), Total and "sum / cap", Points to spend, then a row per skill with points (name, "+n" in blue, right at x 176), 19 apart; "Click one to find it" under them, or "None". "zoom": - and + as Button, the zoom as a figure that flies home. "card": the picked node, skill or bead at the right, its bottom at y 616, with Take (Button Take) when it can be taken. "tip": what the pointer is on, beside it, 190 wide.
